text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: high-severity - host 'gpu-host-03' unreachable, kubelet NotReady. Autoscaler flagged pending pods. (pd#INC-91234)

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-91234 created and routed to oncall: alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): acked. I’m on it — trying SSH to host now.

alice (oncall): ssh attempt timing out. console ping failing. anyone saw maintenance? @ben (infra)

ben (infra): not scheduled. Checking cloud provider API and recent node events.

alice (oncall): pulling node details: ```kubectl get nodes gpu-host-03 -o wide``` shows "NotReady" and no kubelet heartbeat for ~3m. pods stuck in ContainerCreating on that node.

ben (infra): cloud API shows instance in RUNNING but agent status UNKNOWN. opening provider support ticket. grabbing serial console logs.

carol (sre): tagging customers in the internal incident channel. early check: 2 active production jobs hit reduced throughput; routing fallback to other nodes looks okay but latency spikes on some routes.

alice (oncall): serial console extract (last 20 lines): ```[  123.456789] kernel: NMI: watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#2 stuck for 23s``` possible host-level hang.

ben (infra): that looks like kernel lockup. trying soft-reboot via provider agent (graceful if possible). if that fails we’ll do hard-reboot.

deploy-bot: FYI - recent runtime deploy to gpu-host pool at 2026-03-14T09:10Z by carol.s. No immediate failures reported at deploy time.

alice (oncall): initiating provider soft-reboot attempt now. will monitor kubelet re-register.

pagerduty-bot: INC-91234 acknowledged by alice (oncall). Escalation timer paused.

ben (infra): soft-reboot command returned timeout, initiating forced reboot. provider warns ephemeral metrics collection will be lost.

alice (oncall): re-checking cluster: control-plane scheduling in progress. kube-scheduler moving pods off gpu-host-03 already. customer-facing traffic briefly degraded on embed-service.

carol (sre): posted incident note to #customer-status draft: "We experienced a brief infrastructure issue affecting inference throughput for a subset of GPU-backed workloads. No data was lost. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

ben (infra): host is booting. console now shows kernel messages, kubelet attempting join.

alice (oncall): kubelet back to Ready at 1772105860. rebalanced pods running. marking service checks.

carol (sre): running smoke tests against affected routes. initial latency back to normal. tagging impacted customers for postmortem and next update in 30m.

alice (oncall): handing off to tom (next-oncall) for the rest of the window. leaving notes: suspected kernel soft lockup leading to node hang; provider reboot recovered node; follow-up: collect dmesg + kernel oops, compare kernel version, check nv_driver and monitoring for similar spikes.

tom (next-oncall): taking over. thanks @alice — will grab logs and coordinate postmortem. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: INC-91234 status changed to "Monitoring".

incident-bot: Reaction summary: :white_check_mark: node recovered, :hourglass_flowing_sand: monitoring for regressions, next update/PM in 2-3 hours.
